计算加仓金额，取加仓比例和剩余现金的较小者            add_cash = min(cash * add_percentage, cash * max_investment_ratio - total_investment)            # 扣除交易手续费后的实际加仓金额            add_cash_after_fee = add_cash * (1 - transaction_fee_ratio)            # 加仓后新的持仓量            new_position = add_cash_after_fee / open_price            # 更新总持仓量和平均持仓成本            position += new_position            total_cost = average_cost * (position - new_position) + open_price * new_position            average_cost = total_cost / position            # 更新现金余额和总投资额            cash -= add_cash            total_investment += add_cash    # 更新净资产价值    current_nav = position * open_price + cash    net_asset_value.append(current_nav)    # 将数据记录到列表中，用于后续的可视化和分析    investment_list.append(total_investment)    position_list.append(position)    cash_list.append(cash)    avg_cost_list.append(average_cost)    volume_list.append(volume)    open_price_list.append(open_price)# 创建一个新的DataFrame，用于存储策略的执行数据strategy_data = pd.DataFrame({    'Investment': investment_list,    'Position': position_list,    'Cash': cash_list,    'Average Cost': avg_cost_list,    'Volume': volume_list,    'Open Price': open_price_list,    'Net Asset Value': net_asset_value})# 计算总收益率、年化收益率和Sharpe比率，用于评估策略的表现total_return = (net_asset_value[-1] - initial_investment) / initial_investmentannual_return = (total_return + 1) ** (252 / len(data)) - 1  # 假设一年252个交易日volatility = np.std(np.diff(np.log(net_asset_value))) * np.sqrt(252)  # 波动率的年化值sharpe_ratio = annual_return / volatility  # Sharpe比率# 打印策略执行结果print(f"策略执行完毕，最终持仓量：{position}, 平均成本：{average_cost}, 剩余现金：{cash}, 总投资额：{total_investment}, 总收益率：{total_return:.2%}, 年化收益率：{annual_return:.2%}, Sharpe比率：{sharpe_ratio:.2f}")# 绘制和保存图表，展示策略的各项指标随时间的变化plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))titles = ["The total amount of investment varies over time", "The volume of open interest changes over time", "Remaining cash changes over time", "The average cost changes over time", "Volume changes over time", "The opening price changes over time"]data_lists = [investment_list, position_list, cash_list, avg_cost_list, volume_list, open_price_list]for i, data_list in enumerate(data_lists):    plt.subplot(3, 2, i + 1)    plt.plot(data_list, label=titles[i])    plt.title(titles[i])    plt.legend()plt.tight_layout()plt.savefig('Analysis.png')plt.show()# 使用python-docx库创建一个Word文档，并添加策略的执行结果doc = Document()doc.add_heading('Strategy Performance', level=1)doc.add_paragraph(f"Final Position: {position}") #最终持仓量doc.add_paragraph(f" Average Cost: {average_cost}") #平均成本doc.add_paragraph(f" Remaining Cash: {cash}") #剩余现金doc.add_paragraph(f" Total Investment: {total_investment}") #总投资额doc.add_paragraph(f" Total Return: {total_return:.2%}") #总收益率doc.add_paragraph(f" Annualized Return: {annual_return:.2%}") #年化收益率doc.add_paragraph(f"Sharpe Ratio: {sharpe_ratio:.2f}") #Sharpe比率# 保存Word文档doc.save("Strategy_performance_metrics.docx")# 将策略过程中的数据保存到Excel文件中strategy_data = pd.DataFrame({    'Investment': investment_list,    'Position': position_list,    'Cash': cash_list,    'Average Cost': avg_cost_list,    'Volume': volume_list,    'Open Price': open_price_list,    'Net Asset Value': net_asset_value})with pd.ExcelWriter('Binary_Tree_Addition_Strategy_Data.xlsx') as writer:    strategy_data.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Original Data')    # 创建一个新的DataFrame来存储策略的统计指标    stats_data = pd.DataFrame({        'Metric': ['Total Return', 'Annualized Return', 'Sharpe Ratio'],        'Value': [total_return, annual_return, sharpe_ratio]    })    # 保存到Excel的新Sheet    stats_data.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Performance Metrics', index=False)

策略执行完毕，最终持仓量：131.15577835558852, 平均成本：2615.8794406130082, 剩余现金：656878.983780398, 总投资额：343121.0162196024, 总收益率：10714.30%, 年化收益率：40.83%, Sharpe比率：5.96

entry.title: 跨期套利
entry.content:
跨期套利策略分析

Inter-delivery strategy.py

import pandas as pdimport matplotlib.pyplot as pltfrom statsmodels.tsa.stattools import adfuller, cointfrom docx import Documentimport seaborn as snsimport numpy as npdef adf_test(series, name, doc):    # 进行ADF检验    result = adfuller(series, autolag='AIC')        # 向Word文档中添加ADF统计量和p-value    doc.add_paragraph(f"ADF Statistic for {name}: {result[0]:.4f}")    doc.add_paragraph(f"p-value for {name}: {result[1]:.4f}")        # 添加临界值表格    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=5)    table.style = 'Table Grid'    hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells    hdr_cells[0].text = 'Type'    hdr_cells[1].text = 'Value'    hdr_cells[2].text = '1%'    hdr_cells[3].text = '5%'    hdr_cells[4].text = '10%'    row_cells = table.add_row().cells    row_cells[0].text = f'{name}'    row_cells[1].text = f"{result[0]:.4f}"    row_cells[2].text = f"{result[4]['1%']}"    row_cells[3].text = f"{result[4]['5%']}"    row_cells[4].text = f"{result[4]['10%']}"        # 设置图形    fig, ax = plt.subplots()    ax.plot(series, label=f'{name} Series', color='blue', linewidth=2)    ax.set_title(f'ADF Test Result for {name}')    ax.set_xlabel('Date')    ax.set_ylabel('Value')    ax.legend(loc='upper left')        # 添加文本框显示ADF结果，位置调整到图形上部中央    textstr = f'ADF Statistic: {result[0]:.4f}\nP-value: {result[1]:.4f}'    props = dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5)    ax.text(0.5, 0.9, textstr, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=12,            verticalalignment='top', horizontalalignment='center', bbox=props)        # 保存并显示图形    fig.savefig(f'adf_test_{name}.png')    plt.show()        return resultdef adf_test2(series, name):    result = adfuller(series, autolag='AIC')    results_dict = {        'ADF Statistic': [result[0]],        'p-value': [result[1]],        '1%': [result[4]['1%']],        '5%': [result[4]['5%']],        '10%': [result[4]['10%']]    }    return pd.DataFrame(results_dict, index=[name])# 添加计算最大回撤的函数def max_drawdown(return_list):    max_value = float('-inf')    max_drawdown = 0    for i in return_list:        max_value = max(max_value, i)        max_drawdown = min(max_drawdown, (i - max_value) / max_value if max_value != 0 else 0)    return max_drawdown# 添加计算夏普比率的函数def sharpe_ratio(return_list, risk_free_rate=0.00):      std = np.std(return_list)    if std == 0:        return None    mean = np.mean(return_list)    sharpe_ratio = (mean - risk_free_rate) / std    return sharpe_ratiodata = pd.read_excel('E:\\豆粕合约.xlsx')contracts = ['m2408', 'm2409', 'm2411', 'm2412', 'm2501', 'm2503']prices = data[['Date'] + contracts]prices.set_index('Date', inplace=True)doc = Document()doc.add_heading('Inter-delivery Strategy Analysis with Six Contracts', level=1)# 计算相关系数矩阵correlation_matrix = prices.corr()# 使用Seaborn库绘制热力图plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', fmt=".2f", linewidths=.5)plt.title('Correlation Matrix Heatmap of Futures Contracts')plt.savefig('Correlation Matrix Heatmap.png')plt.show()# 设置画布大小plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))# 绘制每个合约的价格序列for contract in contracts:    plt.plot(prices[contract], label=contract)# 设置图表标题和图例plt.title('Price Series of Futures Contracts')plt.legend()# 保存图形plt.savefig('price_series.png')# 显示图形plt.show()for contract in contracts:    adf_test(prices[contract], contract, doc)pairs = []for i in range(len(contracts)):    for j in range(i + 1, len(contracts)):        coint_stat, p_value, _ = coint(prices[contracts[i]], prices[contracts[j]])        if p_value < 0.05:            pairs.append((contracts[i], contracts[j]))            doc.add_paragraph(f"Cointegration found between {contracts[i]} and {contracts[j]} with p-value: {p_value}")for pair in pairs:    spread = prices[pair[0]] - prices[pair[1]]    mean_spread = spread.mean()    std_spread = spread.std()    prices['z_score'] = (spread - mean_spread) / std_spread    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))    plt.plot(prices.index, prices['z_score'], label='Z-Score of Spread')    plt.axhline(y=2, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Upper Threshold (2σ)')    plt.axhline(y=-2, color='g', linestyle='--', label='Lower Threshold (-2σ)')    plt.title(f'Spread and Thresholds for {pair[0]} and {pair[1]}')    plt.legend()    plt.savefig(f'spread_thresholds_{pair[0]}_{pair[1]}.png')    plt.show()        # 生成交易信号    prices['position'] = 0    prices.loc[prices['z_score'] > 2, 'position'] = -1      prices.loc[prices['z_score'] < -2, 'position'] = 1      prices.loc[abs(prices['z_score']) < 0.5, 'position'] = 0      prices['position_flat'] = np.where(abs(prices['position']) == 0, 1, 0)    prices['trade_flag'] = prices['position_flat'].diff()    trade_count = len(prices.loc[prices['trade_flag'] == 1])  # 交易次数    prices['daily_return'] = prices['position'].shift(1) * (prices[pair[0]].pct_change() - prices[pair[1]].pct_change())    prices['cum_profit'] = (1 + prices['daily_return']).cumprod()    prices['trade_return'] = np.where(prices['trade_flag'] == 1, prices['cum_profit'].shift() - 1, np.nan)    profit_count = sum(prices['trade_return'] > 0)  # 盈利次数    prices['cumulative_return'] = (1 + prices['daily_return']).cumprod() - 1    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))    plt.plot(prices.index, prices['cumulative_return'], label='Cumulative Returns')    plt.title(f'Cumulative Returns from Arbitrage Strategy for {pair[0]} and {pair[1]}')    plt.xlabel('Date')    plt.ylabel('Cumulative Return')    plt.legend()    plt.savefig(f'arbitrage_cumulative_returns_{pair[0]}_{pair[1]}.png')    plt.show()        win_rate = profit_count / trade_count if trade_count > 0 else None  # 胜率     mdd = max_drawdown(prices['cumulative_return'])  # 最大回撤    sharpe = sharpe_ratio(prices['daily_return'])  # 夏普比率    # 插入Word中    doc.add_paragraph(f'Performance Attribution metrics for pair {pair}')    doc.add_paragraph(f'Total trades: {trade_count}')    doc.add_paragraph(f'Number of profitable trades: {profit_count}')    doc.add_paragraph(f'Winning rate: {win_rate if win_rate is not None else "N/A"}')    doc.add_paragraph(f'Maximum drawdown: {mdd:.4f}')    doc.add_paragraph(f'Sharpe ratio: {sharpe if sharpe is not None else "N/A"}')doc.save("Inter-delivery_strategy.docx")# 创建Excel文件with pd.ExcelWriter('Inter-delivery_strategy_analysis.xlsx') as writer:    # 将原始价格数据保存到Excel    prices.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Original Price Data')        # 将相关系数矩阵保存到Excel    correlation_matrix.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Correlation Matrix')    # 保存每个合约的ADF测试结果    adf_results = pd.DataFrame()    for contract in contracts:        adf_result = adf_test2(prices[contract], contract)        adf_result.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=f'ADF Results - {contract}')        adf_results = pd.concat([adf_results, adf_result])    # 保存协整对分析结果    pairs = []    coint_results = pd.DataFrame()    for i in range(len(contracts)):        for j in range(i + 1, len(contracts)):            coint_stat, p_value, _ = coint(prices[contracts[i]], prices[contracts[j]])            if p_value < 0.05:                pairs.append((contracts[i], contracts[j]))                coint_results = coint_results.append({                    'Pair': f'{contracts[i]} - {contracts[j]}',                    'Coint Stat': coint_stat,                    'p-value': p_value                }, ignore_index=True)    coint_results.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Cointegration Results')

entry.title: 趋势交易
entry.content:
趋势交易策略分析

MACD indicator trading strategy.py

import pandas as pdimport numpy as npimport matplotlib.pyplot as pltimport pandas_ta as tafrom matplotlib.pyplot import MultipleLocatorfrom docx import Documentdef calculate_max_drawdown(cumulative_returns):    # 通过累计回报计算资金曲线，取1加上回报序列即可    portfolio_values = 1 + cumulative_returns    # 计算累计最高值    running_max = portfolio_values.cummax()    # 计算回撤    drawdowns = 1 - portfolio_values / running_max    # 计算最大回撤    max_drawdown = drawdowns.max()    return max_drawdown# 从excel中加载数据data = pd.read_excel('E:\\MZL.DCE豆粕主连.xlsx')# 对时间进行格式化data['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['Date'])# 计算MACD指标data['MACD'], data['MACD_Signal'], data['MACD_Hist'] = ta.macd(data['Close'])# 计算EMA12、EMA26、DIF、DEA、以及MACDshort_period = 12long_period = 26dea_period = 5data['EMA12'] = data['Close'].ewm(span=short_period).mean()data['EMA26'] = data['Close'].ewm(span=long_period).mean()data['DIF'] = data['EMA12'] - data['EMA26']data['DEA'] = data['DIF'].ewm(span=dea_period).mean()data['MACD'] = 2 * (data['DIF'] - data['DEA'])# 初始化仓位position = 0buy_signals, sell_signals = [], []trades = []# 更新买入和卖出信号, 执行交易逻辑data['Buy_Signal_Flag'] = 0data['Sell_Signal_Flag'] = 0for i in range(1, len(data)):    row_today = data.iloc[i]    row_yesterday = data.iloc[i - 1]    # 当价格突破上轨，买入开仓    if (row_yesterday['MACD'] > 0) and (row_yesterday['DIF'] > row_yesterday['DEA']):        if position != 1:            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Buy_Signal_Flag'] = 1            buy_signals.append((i, row_yesterday['Close']))            trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Buy', 'type':'Open', 'Price': row_yesterday['Close'], 'Date':row_today.name})            position = 1            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Return'] = (row_today['Close'] - row_yesterday['Close']) / row_today['Close']    # 当价格跌穿下轨，卖出开仓    if (row_yesterday['MACD'] < 0) and (row_yesterday['DIF'] < row_yesterday['DEA']):        if position != -1:            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Sell_Signal_Flag'] = -1            sell_signals.append((i, row_yesterday['Close']))            trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Sell', 'type':'Open', 'Price': row_yesterday['Close'], 'Date':row_today.name})            position = -1            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Return'] = (row_yesterday['Close'] - row_today['Close']) / row_today['Close']                # 市场收盘，清空仓位    if position != 0:        if position == 1:            sell_signals.append((i, row_today['Close']))            trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Sell', 'type':'Close', 'Price':row_today['Close'], 'Date':row_today.name})        if position == -1:            buy_signals.append((i, row_today['Close']))            trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Buy', 'type':'Close', 'Price':row_today['Close'], 'Date':row_today.name})        position = 0# 根据清理后的数据计算累计收益率data['Cumulative_Return'] = (1 + data['Return']).cumprod() - 1# 创建DataFramebuy_signals_df = pd.DataFrame(buy_signals, columns=['Index', 'Price'])sell_signals_df = pd.DataFrame(sell_signals, columns=['Index', 'Price'])trades_df = pd.DataFrame(trades)# 计算置信区间data['Confidence_Interval_Upper_Track'] = data['Close'] + 1.96 * np.std(data['Close'])data['Confidence_Interval_Lower_Track'] = data['Close'] - 1.96 * np.std(data['Close'])#找出计算MACD时的买卖信号点data['Buy_Signal'] = np.where((data['MACD'] > 0) & (data['DIF'] > data['DEA']), data['Close'], np.nan)data['Sell_Signal'] = np.where((data['MACD'] < 0) & (data['DIF'] < data['DEA']), data['Close'], np.nan)# 绘图fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, sharex=True, figsize=(12,8))ax1.plot(data['Close'], label='Close', color='blue')ax1.fill_between(data.index,data['Confidence_Interval_Lower_Track'], data['Confidence_Interval_Upper_Track'], color='gray', alpha=0.3)ax1.plot(data.index, data['Buy_Signal'], marker='^', markersize=12, lw=0, color='g', label='buy')ax1.plot(data.index, data['Sell_Signal'], marker='v', markersize=12, lw=0, color='r', label='sell')ax1.legend(loc='upper left')ax1.set_title('Close and Confidence Interval')ax2.plot(data['DIF'], label='DIF', color='orange')ax2.plot(data['DEA'], label='DEA', color='purple')ax2.bar(data.index, data['MACD'], label='MACD', color='gray', alpha=0.3)ax2.xaxis.set_major_locator(MultipleLocator(250)) ax2.legend(loc='upper left')ax2.set_title('MACD Indicator')plt.tight_layout()plt.savefig('Close_Price_and_MACD_Analysis.png')plt.show()# 确认买入卖出时机buy_signals = [index for index, value in zip(data.index, data['Buy_Signal_Flag']) if value == 1]sell_signals = [index for index, value in zip(data.index, data['Sell_Signal_Flag']) if value == -1]if len(buy_signals) == 0 or len(sell_signals) == 0:    print("No enough buy and sell signals generated. Please check your data and strategy.")else:    # 确保卖出在买入之后，买入在卖出之前    buy_signals_filtered = [idx for idx in buy_signals if idx < max(sell_signals)]    sell_signals_filtered = [idx for idx in sell_signals if idx > min(buy_signals_filtered)]    # 计算交易次数（每次买入信号到紧邻的卖出信号算一次交易）    trade_count = min(len(buy_signals_filtered), len(sell_signals_filtered))    # 计算盈利次数    profit_times = 0    for i in range(trade_count):        # 找到当前买入点之后的第一个卖出点        buy_price = data['Close'][buy_signals_filtered[i]]        sell_price = data['Close'][sell_signals_filtered[i]]        if sell_price > buy_price:            # 如果卖出价高于买入价，说明这次交易盈利，投资成功            profit_times += 1    # 计算胜率    win_rate = profit_times / trade_count# 确保数据都是有效的data = data[~data['Return'].isna()]# 确保数据都是有效的data = data.dropna(subset=['Return'])# 使用上述函数计算最大回撤max_drawdown = calculate_max_drawdown(data['Cumulative_Return'])# 生成累计收益率图plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))plt.plot(data.index, data['Cumulative_Return'], label='Cumulative Return', color='green')plt.title('Cumulative Return')plt.xlabel('Date')plt.ylabel('Cumulative Return')plt.legend()plt.savefig('MACD_indicator_trading_strategy_Cumulative_Return_Analysis.png')plt.show()# 计算夏普比率risk_free_rate = 0.03  # 年无风险利率为3%daily_return = data['Return']  # 每日收益率daily_std = daily_return.std()  # 每日收益率的标准差average_daily_return = daily_return.mean()  # 每日收益率的平均值# 将年无风险利率转换为每日无风险利率daily_risk_free_rate = (1 + risk_free_rate) ** (1/360) - 1  # 假设一年有360个交易日# 计算夏普比率sharpe_ratio = (average_daily_return - daily_risk_free_rate) / daily_std# 创建一个文档对象doc = Document()# 将业绩归因的指标添加到文档中doc.add_heading('MACD indicator trading strategy')doc.add_paragraph(f"Total number of trades: {trade_count}")doc.add_paragraph(f"Total number of profitable trades: {profit_times}")doc.add_paragraph(f"Win rate: {win_rate*100}%")doc.add_paragraph("The maximum drawdown : {:.2%}".format(max_drawdown))doc.add_paragraph(f"Sharpe Ratio: {sharpe_ratio}")# 保存文档doc.save("MACD_indicator_trading_strategy.docx")# 创建一个ExcelWriter对象with pd.ExcelWriter('MACD_indicator_trading_strategy_output_data.xlsx') as writer:    data.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Original Data')    buy_signals_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Buy Signals', index=False)    sell_signals_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Sell Signals', index=False)    trades_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Trades', index=False)

Dual Thrust strategy.py

import pandas as pdimport matplotlib.pyplot as pltfrom docx import Documentdef calculate_max_drawdown(cumulative_returns):    portfolio_values = 1 + cumulative_returns    running_max = portfolio_values.cummax()    drawdowns = 1 - portfolio_values / running_max    max_drawdown = drawdowns.max()    return max_drawdown# 从excel中加载数据data = pd.read_excel('E:\\MZL.DCE豆粕主连.xlsx')# 对时间进行格式化data['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['Date'])# Dual Thrust策略N = 5 K1 = 0.5 K2 = 0.5data['HH'] = data['High'].rolling(window=N).max()data['LC'] = data['Close'].rolling(window=N).min()data['HC'] = data['Close'].rolling(window=N).max()data['LL'] = data['Low'].rolling(window=N).min()# 计算Rangedata['Range'] = data[['HH', 'LC', 'HC', 'LL']].apply(lambda x: max(x['HH'] - x['LC'], x['HC'] - x['LL']), axis=1)data['BuyLine'] = data['Open'] + K1 * data['Range']data['SellLine'] = data['Open'] - K2 * data['Range']# 初始化仓位position = 0buy_signals, sell_signals = [], []trades = []# 更新买入和卖出信号, 执行交易逻辑data['Buy_Signal_Flag'] = 0data['Sell_Signal_Flag'] = 0data['Return'] = 0for i in range(N, len(data)):    row_today = data.iloc[i]    row_yesterday = data.iloc[i - 1]    if row_today['High'] > row_yesterday['BuyLine'] and row_today['Low'] <= row_yesterday['BuyLine']:        if position <= 0 and row_today['Open'] > row_yesterday['BuyLine']:            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Buy_Signal_Flag'] = 1            buy_signals.append((i, row_yesterday['BuyLine']))            position += 1             trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Buy', 'Price':row_yesterday['BuyLine'], 'Date':row_today.name})            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Return'] = (row_today['Close'] - row_yesterday['BuyLine']) / row_yesterday['BuyLine']    if row_today['Low'] < row_yesterday['SellLine'] and row_today['High'] >= row_yesterday['SellLine']:        if position >= 0 and row_today['Open'] < row_yesterday['SellLine']:            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Sell_Signal_Flag'] = -1            sell_signals.append((i, row_yesterday['SellLine']))            position -= 1            trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Sell', 'Price':row_yesterday['SellLine'], 'Date':row_today.name})            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Return'] = (row_yesterday['SellLine'] - row_today['Close']) / row_yesterday['SellLine']        # 市场收盘，清空仓位    if position != 0:        if position == 1:            sell_signals.append((i, row_today['Close']))            trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Sell', 'Price':row_today['Close'], 'Date':row_today.name})        if position == -1:            buy_signals.append((i, row_today['Close']))            trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Buy', 'Price':row_today['Close'], 'Date':row_today.name})        position = 0# 根据清理后的数据计算累计收益率data['Cumulative_Return'] = (1 + data['Return']).cumprod() - 1# 创建DataFramebuy_signals_df = pd.DataFrame(buy_signals, columns=['Index', 'Price'])sell_signals_df = pd.DataFrame(sell_signals, columns=['Index', 'Price'])trades_df = pd.DataFrame(trades)# 修改确保所有没有买卖操作的交易日收益为 0data.loc[(data['Buy_Signal_Flag'] == 0) & (data['Sell_Signal_Flag'] == 0), 'Return'] = 0# 画出价格和突破点plt.figure(figsize=(12,8))plt.plot(data.index, data['Close'], label='Close Price', color='blue')plt.scatter([trade['Date'] for trade in trades if trade['Trade_Type']=='Buy'], trades_df[trades_df['Trade_Type']=='Buy']['Price'], color='green',label='Buy Signal', marker='^', alpha=1)plt.scatter([trade['Date'] for trade in trades if trade['Trade_Type']=='Sell'], trades_df[trades_df['Trade_Type']=='Sell']['Price'], color='red',label='Sell Signal', marker='v', alpha=1)plt.title('Prices and Buy and Sell Signals of Dual Thrust Strategy')plt.xlabel('Date')plt.ylabel('Price')plt.legend()plt.savefig('Prices_and_Buy_and_Sell_Signals_of_Dual_Thrust_Strategy.png')plt.show()# 确定交易买卖点buy_signals = [index for index, value in zip(data.index, data['Buy_Signal_Flag']) if value == 1]sell_signals = [index for index, value in zip(data.index, data['Sell_Signal_Flag']) if value == -1]if len(buy_signals) == 0 or len(sell_signals) == 0:    print("No buy and sell signals generated. Please check the data and strategy.")else:    # 确保卖出在买入之后，买入在卖出之前    buy_signals_filtered = [idx for idx in buy_signals if idx < max(sell_signals)]    sell_signals_filtered = [idx for idx in sell_signals if idx > min(buy_signals_filtered)]    # 计算交易次数（每次买入信号到紧邻的卖出信号算一次交易）    trade_count = min(len(buy_signals_filtered), len(sell_signals_filtered))    # 计算盈利次数    profit_times = 0    for i in range(trade_count):        # 找到当前买入点之后的第一个卖出点        buy_price = data['Close'][buy_signals_filtered[i]]        sell_price = data['Close'][sell_signals_filtered[i]]        if sell_price > buy_price:            # 如果卖出价高于买入价，说明这次交易盈利，投资成功            profit_times += 1    # 计算胜率    win_rate = profit_times / trade_count# 确保数据都是有效的data = data[~data['Return'].isna()]# 计算最大回撤max_drawdown = calculate_max_drawdown(data['Cumulative_Return'])# 生成累计收益率图plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))plt.plot(data.index, data['Cumulative_Return'], label='Cumulative Return', color='green')plt.title('Cumulative Return')plt.xlabel('Date')plt.ylabel('Cumulative Return')plt.legend()plt.savefig('Dual_Thrust_Strategy_Cumulative_Return_Analysis.png')plt.show()# 计算夏普比率risk_free_rate = 0.03  # 年无风险利率为3%daily_return = data['Return']  # 每日收益率daily_std = daily_return.std()  # 每日收益率的标准差average_daily_return = daily_return.mean()  # 每日收益率的平均值# 将年无风险利率转换为每日无风险利率daily_risk_free_rate = (1 + risk_free_rate) ** (1/360) - 1  # 假设一年有360个交易日# 计算夏普比率sharpe_ratio = (average_daily_return - daily_risk_free_rate) / daily_std# 创建Document对象doc = Document()# 添加业绩归因指标到文档中doc.add_heading('Dual Thrust strategy')doc.add_paragraph(f"Total number of trades: {trade_count}")doc.add_paragraph(f"Total number of profitable trades: {profit_times}")doc.add_paragraph(f"Win rate: {win_rate*100}%")doc.add_paragraph("The maximum drawdown : {:.2%}".format(max_drawdown))doc.add_paragraph(f"Sharpe Ratio: {sharpe_ratio}")# 保存文档doc.save("Dual_Thrust_strategy.docx")# 创建一个ExcelWriter对象with pd.ExcelWriter('Dual_Thrust_strategy_output_data.xlsx') as writer:    data.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Original Data')    buy_signals_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Buy Signals', index=False)    sell_signals_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Sell Signals', index=False)    trades_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Trades', index=False)

import pandas as pdimport numpy as npimport matplotlib.pyplot as pltfrom docx import Document# ATR计算函数def calculate_atr(data: pd.DataFrame, period: int=14) -> pd.Series:    high = data['High']    low = data['Low']    close = data['Close']        high_low = high - low    high_close = np.abs(high - close.shift())    low_close = np.abs(low - close.shift())        ranges = pd.concat([high_low, high_close, low_close], axis=1)    true_range = ranges.max(axis=1)    atr = true_range.rolling(period).mean()    return atrdef calculate_max_drawdown(cumulative_returns):    portfolio_values = 1 + cumulative_returns    running_max = portfolio_values.cummax()    drawdowns = 1 - portfolio_values / running_max    max_drawdown = drawdowns.max()    return max_drawdown# 从excel中加载数据data = pd.read_excel('E:\\MZL.DCE豆粕主连.xlsx')# 对时间进行格式化data['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['Date'])# ATR策略N = 10M = 1# 计算ATRdata['ATR'] = calculate_atr(data, N)# 计算上下轨data['Upper_Track'] = data['Open'] + M * data['ATR']data['Lower_Track'] = data['Open'] - M * data['ATR']# 初始化仓位position = 0buy_signals, sell_signals = [], []trades = []data['Return'] = 0for i in range(N, len(data)):    row_today = data.iloc[i]    row_yesterday = data.iloc[i-1]    # 回到市场收盘    if row_today['High'] > row_yesterday['Upper_Track'] and row_today['Low'] <= row_yesterday['Upper_Track']:        if position != 1 and row_today['Open'] > row_yesterday['Upper_Track']:            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Buy_Signal_Flag'] = 1            buy_signals.append((i, row_yesterday['Upper_Track']))            position = 1             trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Buy', 'Price':row_yesterday['Upper_Track'], 'Date':row_today.name})            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Return'] = (row_today['Close'] - row_yesterday['Upper_Track']) / row_yesterday['Upper_Track']    # 进入市场开盘    if row_today['Low'] < row_yesterday['Lower_Track'] and row_today['High'] >= row_yesterday['Lower_Track']:        if position != -1 and row_today['Open'] < row_yesterday['Upper_Track']:            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Sell_Signal_Flag'] = -1            sell_signals.append((i, row_yesterday['Lower_Track']))            position = -1            trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Sell', 'Price':row_yesterday['Lower_Track'], 'Date':row_today.name})            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Return'] = (row_yesterday['Lower_Track'] - row_today['Close']) / row_yesterday['Lower_Track']    # 市场收盘，清空仓位    if position != 0:        if position == 1:            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Sell_Signal_Flag'] = -1            sell_signals.append((i, row_today['Close']))            trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Sell', 'Price':row_today['Close'], 'Date':row_today.name})        if position == -1:            data.loc[row_today.name, 'Buy_Signal_Flag'] = 1            buy_signals.append((i, row_today['Close']))            trades.append({'Trade_Type':'Buy', 'Price':row_today['Close'], 'Date':row_today.name})        position = 0# 根据清理后的数据计算累计收益率data['Cumulative_Return'] = (1 + data['Return']).cumprod() - 1# 创建DataFramebuy_signals_df = pd.DataFrame(buy_signals, columns=['Index', 'Price'])sell_signals_df = pd.DataFrame(sell_signals, columns=['Index', 'Price'])trades_df = pd.DataFrame(trades)# 画出价格和突破点plt.figure(figsize=(12,8))plt.plot(data.index, data['Close'], label='Close Price', color='blue')plt.plot(data.index, data['Upper_Track'], label='Upper Track', color='red')plt.plot(data.index, data['Lower_Track'], label='Lower Track', color='green')plt.scatter([trade['Date'] for trade in trades if trade['Trade_Type']=='Buy'], trades_df[trades_df['Trade_Type']=='Buy']['Price'], color='green',label='Buy Signal', marker='^', alpha=1)plt.scatter([trade['Date'] for trade in trades if trade['Trade_Type']=='Sell'], trades_df[trades_df['Trade_Type']=='Sell']['Price'], color='red',label='Sell Signal', marker='v', alpha=1)plt.title('Prices and Buy and Sell Signals of ATR Strategy')plt.xlabel('Date')plt.ylabel('Price')plt.legend()plt.savefig('Prices_and_Buy_and_Sell_Signals_of_ATR_Strategy.png')plt.show()# 确认买入卖出时机buy_signals = [index for index, value in zip(data.index, data['Buy_Signal_Flag']) if value == 1]sell_signals = [index for index, value in zip(data.index, data['Sell_Signal_Flag']) if value == -1]if len(buy_signals) == 0 or len(sell_signals) == 0:    print("No enough buy and sell signals generated. Please check your data and strategy.")else:    # 确保卖出在买入之后，买入在卖出之前    buy_signals_filtered = [idx for idx in buy_signals if idx < max(sell_signals)]    sell_signals_filtered = [idx for idx in sell_signals if idx > min(buy_signals_filtered)]    # 计算交易次数（每次买入信号到紧邻的卖出信号算一次交易）    trade_count = min(len(buy_signals_filtered), len(sell_signals_filtered))    # 计算盈利次数    profit_times = 0    for i in range(trade_count):        buy_price = data['Close'][buy_signals_filtered[i]]        sell_price = data['Close'][sell_signals_filtered[i]]        if sell_price > buy_price:            profit_times += 1    # 计算胜率    win_rate = profit_times / trade_count# 确保数据都是有效的data = data[~data['Return'].isna()]# 计算最大回撤max_drawdown = calculate_max_drawdown(data['Cumulative_Return'])# 生成累计收益率图plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))plt.plot(data.index, data['Cumulative_Return'], label='Cumulative Return', color='green')plt.title('Cumulative Return')plt.xlabel('Date')plt.ylabel('Cumulative Return')plt.legend()plt.savefig('ATR_Strategy_Cumulative_Return_Analysis.png')plt.show()# 计算夏普比率risk_free_rate = 0.03  # 年无风险利率为3%daily_return = data['Return']  # 每日收益率daily_std = daily_return.std()  # 每日收益率的标准差average_daily_return = daily_return.mean()  # 每日收益率的平均值# 将年无风险利率转换为每日无风险利率daily_risk_free_rate = (1 + risk_free_rate) ** (1/360) - 1  # 假设一年有360个交易日# 计算夏普比率sharpe_ratio = (average_daily_return - daily_risk_free_rate) / daily_std# 创建Document对象doc = Document()# 添加业绩归因指标到文档中doc.add_heading('ATR strategy')doc.add_paragraph(f"Total number of trades: {trade_count}")doc.add_paragraph(f"Total number of profitable trades: {profit_times}")doc.add_paragraph(f"Win rate: {win_rate*100}%")doc.add_paragraph("The maximum drawdown : {:.2%}".format(max_drawdown))doc.add_paragraph(f"Sharpe Ratio: {sharpe_ratio}")# 保存文档doc.save("ATR_strategy.docx")# 创建一个ExcelWriter对象with pd.ExcelWriter('ATR_strategy_output_data.xlsx') as writer:    data.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Original Data')    buy_signals_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Buy Signals', index=False)    sell_signals_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Sell Signals', index=False)    trades_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Trades', index=False)
